Earlier this year in May, OpenAI launched a dedicated enterprise mobile app. Now SpaceXAI is doing the same with Grok.

Grok for Intune officially launches

This enterprise-focused app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI describes this brand-new dedicated app as "the Microsoft Intune version of Grok, the AI assistant developed by xAI—designed specifically for organisations that manage apps and data through Intune."

They say: "It supports Intune mobile application management, complies with corporate app protection policies, and can be signed in with a company email."

SpaceXAI lists the following features of Grok for Intune:

AI Assistant　Ask any question and get instant answers, conduct in-depth research online, or work through tough maths, science and coding problems. Upload files and photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyse and explain the content. Grok Imagine　Generate eye-catching images with simple text prompts, or upload a picture and let Grok edit it for you—remove objects, change the scene, or apply any artistic style. Create short videos with text prompts paired with sound, or turn static photos into videos. Voice Mode　Chat with Grok and get natural voice replies, hands-free. Live Camera: Share what you see in front of you and let Grok analyse and reason about it in real time. Real-Time Information　With access to web and X data, Grok's answers can keep you up to date on the latest news, trends and developments on any topic. Built for Managed Devices　Deployed and configured by your IT team through Microsoft Intune. Complies with corporate app protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing and data transfer. Sign in with your company email. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available for download on the App Store.
